questions: What kinds of bills do you have to pay?
How do you usually pay your bills - in cash or by another method? [Why?]
Have you ever forgotten to pay a bill? [Why/Why not?]
Is there anything you could do to make your bills cheaper? [Why/Why not?]

parts.instructions: Describe some food or drink that you learned to prepare.
bullet_points: what food or drink you learned to prepare
when and where you learned to prepare this
how you learned to prepare this
and explain how you felt about learning to prepare this food or drink.

parts.topic: Young people and cooking & Working as a chef
questions: What kinds of things can children learn to cook?
Do you think it is important for children to learn to cook?
Do you think young people should learn to cook at home or at school?
How enjoyable do you think it would be to work as a professional chef?
What skills does a person need to be a great chef?
How much influence do celebrity/TV chefs have on what ordinary people cook?
Do you like chatting with friends? [Why/Why not?]
What do you usually chat about with friends?
Do you prefer to chat with a group of people or with just one friend? [Why?]
Do you prefer to communicate face-to-face or via social media? [Why?]

parts.topic: A person you met at a party
parts.instructions: Describe a person you met at a party and enjoyed talking with.
bullet_points: and explain why you enjoyed talking with this person.

questions: In what situations do people throw parties in your country?
Do you think it's true that people spend too much money on parties these days?
Why do some people dislike attending large social gatherings?
How easy is it for people to meet new friends in your city?
Are there any differences in the ways young and old people make new friends?
Do you think people are more confident talking to strangers now than in the past?
Do you always bring a lot of keys with you? [Why/Why not?]
Have you ever lost your keys? [What happened?]
Do you often forget where you put your keys? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think it's a good idea to leave your keys with a neighbour? [Why/Why not?]

parts.instructions: Describe a website you often visit.
bullet_points: how you found out about it
and explain why you often visit this website.

questions: What are the most popular types of websites in your country?
Do you think people spend too much time on the internet these days?
How has the internet changed the way people buy and sell things?
What are the dangers of sharing personal information on the internet?
Do you think older people find it more difficult to use the internet than younger people?
In the future, do you think people will read news exclusively online?
Do you like wearing T-shirts? [Why/Why not?]
How often do you wear T-shirts?
Do you like T-shirts with pictures or prints on them? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think older people should wear T-shirts? [Why/Why not?]

parts.instructions: Describe a piece of good news you heard from others.
bullet_points: and explain how you felt when you heard this good news.

questions: How do people usually share good news in your country?
Do you think it's better to tell someone good news face-to-face or on the phone?
Why do you think people like to share good news on social media?
Do you agree that the news we see on television is mostly negative?
Why do news media programs often focus on bad news rather than good news?
How does reading or watching negative news affect people's moods?
